title: EvoSkillTrace
description: A scene execution trace collected for EvoSkill learning. Captures agent I/O, routing decisions, and quality scores for failure/success classification.

trace_id.description: Unique identifier for this trace record.

series_id.description: Series namespace this trace belongs to.

book_id.description: Book within the series that generated this trace.

trace_type.description: Whether the scene run succeeded or was classified as a failure.

failure_mode.description: Specific failure mode for failed traces; null for successful traces.

agent_inputs.description: Map of agent_id to hashed input digest.

agent_outputs.description: Map of agent_id to hashed output digest.

routing_decisions.description: Ordered list of routing decisions made during scene generation (e.g. REVISE, RE_PLAN, GO).

quality_scores.description: Map of quality metric name to numeric score.

critic_scores.description: Map of critic agent name to numeric score.

word_count.description: Word count of the final_text at time of trace collection.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the trace was collected.
